lines.text: as night settles over the white sand beach.
In contrast to the darkness around them, a campfire burns brightly
as Tia, Naga, and Little Mermaid gather around its flames.

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: Okay, when I count to three, we all say it together.

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: Hehe, I knew you'd say that.

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: How could we not? You make it so obvious.

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: when did you start falling for Teacher?

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: Was it love at first sight?

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: Or did you fall for him after spending time together...?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: At first, I just thought he was cool...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: But the more time we spent together, the more...

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: Easy there, Tia. Don't push her too hard.

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: You look pretty curious too, Naga!

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: Aw, I was hoping I wouldn't have to use this, but...

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: Sooo, are you gonna tell us now?
The three of them are all tangled together, laughing happily.
We're hiding behind a box near the campfire, crouched down as small as possible.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Commander, I suggest wiping that smile off your face.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Before it gets stuck that way.
Besides, you're the one who dragged me here, saying there was something interesting...

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: If you don't lower your voice, we'll be discovered.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: the moment those three realize you've been listening in.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: But this is something I should say to you directly.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Commander, there's something I need to tell you.
It's fine. I think I already know without hearing it...

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: By the way, how long are we going to keep hiding here and listening in?
Says the person who wanted us to hide and listen in in the first place.
... But we should probably get out of here before they notice us.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Then I'll go first and distract them.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: While I do that, Commander, run the other way.
Do you really think that'll work?

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: It's not like you can go out there and distract them yourself.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Then let's proceed with this plan.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: I'll head out on three. One, two...
What was that? Was that you, Rapi?

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: This place feels different at night.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Yes, it really is dark out here.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Even those... drawings from earlier are impossible to make out now.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: You still have the emergency generator with you, yes?

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Yes, Penguin No. 1 is carrying it.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: I wonder how brightly it'll shine.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Let's head inside and set it up...
The lighthouse suddenly blazes to life.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: Get the penguin on your back.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: Now hurry and take my hand. We're moving now.
This is nothing like the brief tremor from earlier.
The campfire topples over, sending embers scattering in every direction.
I leap to my feet from behind the box and run toward them.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Right now, we need to figure out what's going on.
A massive booming sound rolls in from the direction of the ocean.
The sound of rushing water comes from every direction without stopping,
like waterfalls have suddenly appeared all around us.
The next moment, I can feel the ground beneath my feet tilting.
Out of the darkness, Cinderella comes flying in carrying Marciana and Penguin No. 1.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Naga! Tia! Are you two okay?

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: We're all right. What's the situation?

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: I rushed over here myself, so I didn't get a good look either.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Commander, I'll go with Cinderella and check it out.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: You want to take a look from above?
Cinderella and Rapi soar into the night sky together.
Within moments, they disappear into the darkness.
As Rapi and Cinderella soar into the sky, they look down below.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: ... Rapi, over there. Near the edge of the island.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: There's something just beneath the surface.
The two lower their altitude and fly along the island's edge.
The closer they get to the water, the clearer the outline becomes.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Something massive extends beneath the island.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: This island is a Land Eater?!
Marciana stands beside Naga and Tia.
In the distance, the lighthouse shines brightly.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: I will protect both of you.
WAVE TO YOU: To Be Continued...
